name: John Smith
bioAdditions: Path (Pelletreau S1): Bull Smith -> Daniel -> Daniel 2d -> Mary (b. 25 May 1735, m. Judge William Smith of the Tangier family) -> John: 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Pelletreau adds that for his third wife he married the widow of Henry Nicoll, a daughter of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull, so he became stepfather of Eliza W. Nicoll, mother of Judge J. Lawrence Smith.
